verdict.rationale: RustDesk is a remote desktop and self-hosted relay product, not an automation or workflow platform, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships automations. The closest items, the Server Pro management API and centralized settings, are administrative features and do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
